label: ZKN_PEARL_001_000
text:
For some time after its birth, it grows by taking
nourishment from the seed on its back.

label: ZKN_PEARL_002_000
text:
When the bud on its back starts swelling,
a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s
coming bloom.

label: ZKN_PEARL_003_000
text:
After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells
stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_004_000
text:
The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of
its life. If the Pokémon is healthy, its tail
burns intensely.

label: ZKN_PEARL_005_000
text:
In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live,
their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

label: ZKN_PEARL_006_000
text:
It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if
it has experienced harsh battles.

label: ZKN_PEARL_007_000
text:
It hides in its shell to protect itself, then strikes
back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

label: ZKN_PEARL_008_000
text:
It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is
popular as a symbol of longevity.

label: ZKN_PEARL_009_000
text:
The jets of water it spouts from the rocket
cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

label: ZKN_PEARL_010_000
text:
It releases a stench from its red antennae to repel
enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

label: ZKN_PEARL_011_000
text:
A steel-hard shell protects its tender body.
The Pokémon quietly endures hardships while
awaiting evolution.

label: ZKN_PEARL_012_000
text:
It loves the nectar of flowers and can locate
flower patches that have even tiny amounts
of pollen.

label: ZKN_PEARL_013_000
text:
It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off
attackers with the needle on its head.

label: ZKN_PEARL_014_000
text:
While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators
under leaves and in nooks of branches.

label: ZKN_PEARL_015_000
text:
Its best attack involves flying around at high
speed, striking with poison needles, then
flying off.

label: ZKN_PEARL_016_000
text:
It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict.
If disturbed, however, it can ferociously
strike back.

label: ZKN_PEARL_017_000
text:
It flies over its wide territory in search of prey,
downing it with its highly developed claws.

label: ZKN_PEARL_018_000
text:
By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot
can make a gust of wind capable of bending
tall trees.

label: ZKN_PEARL_019_000
text:
It’s cautious in the extreme, and its hardy vitality
lets it live in any kind of environment.

label: ZKN_PEARL_020_000
text:
It whittles down its constantly growing fangs
by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart
cinder block walls.

label: ZKN_PEARL_021_000
text:
It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak,
it searches in grass for prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_022_000
text:
It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad
wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

label: ZKN_PEARL_023_000
text:
It sneaks through grass without making a sound
and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

label: ZKN_PEARL_024_000
text:
The pattern on its belly is for intimidation.
It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

label: ZKN_PEARL_025_000
text:
If it looses crackling power from the electric
sacs on its cheeks, it is being wary.

label: ZKN_PEARL_026_000
text:
It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity,
instantly downing foes several times its size.

label: ZKN_PEARL_027_000
text:
To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a
ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

label: ZKN_PEARL_028_000
text:
It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back.
Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

label: ZKN_PEARL_029_000
text:
While this Pokémon does not prefer to fight,
even one drop of the venom it secretes from its
barbs can be fatal.

label: ZKN_PEARL_030_000
text:
When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs
on its body. These barbs grow more slowly
than Nidorino’s.

label: ZKN_PEARL_031_000
text:
Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will
protect the young in its burrow with its life.

label: ZKN_PEARL_032_000
text:
It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of
the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

label: ZKN_PEARL_033_000
text:
It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with
its horn, which oozes venom upon impact.

label: ZKN_PEARL_034_000
text:
One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone
pole as if it were a matchstick.

label: ZKN_PEARL_035_000
text:
Moonlight gathers on the wings on Clefairy’s
back, allowing Clefairy to fly. This Pokémon is
difficult to find.

label: ZKN_PEARL_036_000
text:
Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over
half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

label: ZKN_PEARL_037_000
text:
It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails
split from their tips to make more tails.

label: ZKN_PEARL_038_000
text:
Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a
mystic power. The Pokémon is said to live
for 1,000 years.

label: ZKN_PEARL_039_000
text:
When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins
singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

label: ZKN_PEARL_040_000
text:
Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can
expand its body by inhaling air.

label: ZKN_PEARL_041_000
text:
Disliking sunlight, it sleeps deep in forests and
caves until sundown.

label: ZKN_PEARL_042_000
text:
Once it starts sucking blood, it does not stop
until it is full. It flies at night in search of prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_043_000
text:
It often plants its root feet in the ground during
the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

label: ZKN_PEARL_044_000
text:
The nectar it drools from its mouth smells so
atrocious that it can make noses curl from more
than a mile away.

label: ZKN_PEARL_045_000
text:
Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks,
it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

label: ZKN_PEARL_046_000
text:
Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back.
They grow along with the host Paras.

label: ZKN_PEARL_047_000
text:
It is controlled by the mushroom, which has
grown larger than the bug body. It is said to
prefer damp places.

label: ZKN_PEARL_048_000
text:
Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes.
At night, its kind is drawn by light.

label: ZKN_PEARL_049_000
text:
It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales.
The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

label: ZKN_PEARL_050_000
text:
This Pokémon lives underground. Because of its
dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

label: ZKN_PEARL_051_000
text:
Its three heads move alternately, driving it
through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

label: ZKN_PEARL_052_000
text:
It is nocturnal by nature. If it spots something
shiny, its eyes glitter as brightly as the
shiny object.

label: ZKN_PEARL_053_000
text:
It is a very haughty Pokémon. Among fans of
Persian, the size of the jewel in its forehead is
a topic of much talk.

label: ZKN_PEARL_054_000
text:
It never remembers using its odd powers, so it
always tilts its head in puzzlement.

label: ZKN_PEARL_055_000
text:
The flippers of its well-developed limbs give it
shocking speed. It is the best swimmer
among Pokémon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_056_000
text:
It lives in treetop colonies. If one member of
the group becomes enraged, the whole colony
rampages for no reason.

label: ZKN_PEARL_057_000
text:
It becomes angry if it sees an opponent’s eyes
and gets angrier if the opponent runs. Even after
it beats the opponent, it is still angry.

label: ZKN_PEARL_058_000
text:
It is a Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain
motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

label: ZKN_PEARL_059_000
text:
Its proud and regal appearance has captured the
hearts of people since long ago.

label: ZKN_PEARL_060_000
text:
Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible.
It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

label: ZKN_PEARL_061_000
text:
The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates.
Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

label: ZKN_PEARL_062_000
text:
With its extremely tough muscles, it could keep
swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

label: ZKN_PEARL_063_000
text:
Even while asleep, it maintains a telepathic radar.
It teleports when it is threatened.

label: ZKN_PEARL_064_000
text:
When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong
alpha waves that can ruin precision instruments.

label: ZKN_PEARL_065_000
text:
Its highly developed brain is on par with a
supercomputer. It can use all forms of
psychic abilities.

label: ZKN_PEARL_066_000
text:
Its muscles never cramp however much it trains.
It lives in the mountains away from humans.

label: ZKN_PEARL_067_000
text:
It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that
kind of strength, it helps people do heavy jobs.

label: ZKN_PEARL_068_000
text:
It can knock a train flying with a punch. However,
it is terrible at delicate work using its fingers.

label: ZKN_PEARL_069_000
text:
It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick
at capturing prey with its vines.

label: ZKN_PEARL_070_000
text:
This Pokémon has the appearance of a
plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them
with a toxic powder.

label: ZKN_PEARL_071_000
text:
In its mouth, it pools a fragrant nectar-like fluid.
The fluid is really an acid that dissolves anything.

label: ZKN_PEARL_072_000
text:
It drifts in sea currents. Countless fishers are hurt
by its poison stingers.

label: ZKN_PEARL_073_000
text:
It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing
the red orbs on its head.

label: ZKN_PEARL_074_000
text:
It is impossible to distinguish from rocks. It slams
against others in contests of toughness.

label: ZKN_PEARL_075_000
text:
It tumbles down slopes, heedless of any body
parts chipping off. It eats a ton of rocks daily.

label: ZKN_PEARL_076_000
text:
It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves
from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

label: ZKN_PEARL_077_000
text:
Its legs grow strong while it chases after its
parents. It runs all day in fields and on mountains.

label: ZKN_PEARL_078_000
text:
It has astounding acceleration. From a standstill,
it can reach top speed within 10 steps.

label: ZKN_PEARL_079_000
text:
Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail.
It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

label: ZKN_PEARL_080_000
text:
Though usually dim-witted, it seems to become
inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

label: ZKN_PEARL_081_000
text:
The units at its sides generate electromagnetic
waves that keep it airborne. It feeds
on electricity.

label: ZKN_PEARL_082_000
text:
A Magneton is actually three Magnemite linked
by magnetism. A group of these Pokémon can set
off a magnetic storm.

label: ZKN_PEARL_083_000
text:
It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why
it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

label: ZKN_PEARL_084_000
text:
The brains in its two heads appear to
communicate emotions to each other with
a telepathic power.

label: ZKN_PEARL_085_000
text:
When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one
of its heads splits into two. This Pokémon runs at
nearly 40 mph.

label: ZKN_PEARL_086_000
text:
This Pokémon lives on icebergs. It uses the sharp
point on its head to break up ice as it swims in
the sea.

label: ZKN_PEARL_087_000
text:
In snow, the pure white coat covering its body
obscures it from predators.

label: ZKN_PEARL_088_000
text:
It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was
exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears
among filth.

label: ZKN_PEARL_089_000
text:
A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid
kills plants and trees immediately upon contact.

label: ZKN_PEARL_090_000
text:
It swims backward by opening and closing its two
shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

label: ZKN_PEARL_091_000
text:
It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for
protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_092_000
text:
It’s a Pokémon born from poison gases. It defeats
even the largest foes by enveloping them in gas.

label: ZKN_PEARL_093_000
text:
It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal its victim’s
life-force. It lurks in darkness, waiting for prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_094_000
text:
Lurking in the shadowy corners of rooms,
it awaits chances to steal its prey’s life-force.

label: ZKN_PEARL_095_000
text:
It squirms through the ground using its long and
rugged body. It always eats while burrowing.

label: ZKN_PEARL_096_000
text:
It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing
with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

label: ZKN_PEARL_097_000
text:
Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep
in three seconds, even in someone who just
woke up.

label: ZKN_PEARL_098_000
text:
It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches.
Its pincers fully grow back if they are lost in battle.

label: ZKN_PEARL_099_000
text:
The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower
strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult
to aim.

label: ZKN_PEARL_100_000
text:
It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous
because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

label: ZKN_PEARL_101_000
text:
It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to
bursting with stored electricity.

label: ZKN_PEARL_102_000
text:
Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can
quickly gather if they become separated.

label: ZKN_PEARL_103_000
text:
It is called the Walking Jungle. If a head grows
too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

label: ZKN_PEARL_104_000
text:
When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries.
Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

label: ZKN_PEARL_105_000
text:
The bones it uses have been in its possession
since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.

label: ZKN_PEARL_106_000
text:
Its legs can stretch to double their length.
First-time foes are startled by Hitmonlee’s
extensible reach.

label: ZKN_PEARL_107_000
text:
When Hitmonchan twists its arm while throwing a
punch, the blow will pulverize even concrete. The
Pokémon rests after three minutes of fighting.

label: ZKN_PEARL_108_000
text:
Instead of its hands, it uses its tongue, which
can stretch to twice this Pokémon’s height.
Lickitung’s sticky saliva grips anything.

label: ZKN_PEARL_109_000
text:
Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft.
The gases not only smell; they are also explosive.

label: ZKN_PEARL_110_000
text:
It grows by feeding on gases released by
garbage. Though very rare, triplets have
been found.

label: ZKN_PEARL_111_000
text:
Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles
topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.

label: ZKN_PEARL_112_000
text:
Its brain developed after it stood up on its
hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through
solid rock.

label: ZKN_PEARL_113_000
text:
It lays several eggs a day and won’t share them
with those who have evil in their hearts.

label: ZKN_PEARL_114_000
text:
It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the
face hidden behind this growth of vines.

label: ZKN_PEARL_115_000
text:
It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its
baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

label: ZKN_PEARL_116_000
text:
It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses
danger, it spits black ink and flees.

label: ZKN_PEARL_117_000
text:
Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones
are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

label: ZKN_PEARL_118_000
text:
It swims at a steady five knots. If it senses
danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.

label: ZKN_PEARL_119_000
text:
To protect its family, it will fight with its
drill-sharp horn. It lives in hollowed rocks
in streams.

label: ZKN_PEARL_120_000
text:
If Staryu’s body is damaged, it will regenerate as
long as the red core remains. The core flashes
at midnight.

label: ZKN_PEARL_121_000
text:
At the center of its body is a red core that sends
mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

label: ZKN_PEARL_122_000
text:
Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into
invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

label: ZKN_PEARL_123_000
text:
It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking
scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.

label: ZKN_PEARL_124_000
text:
Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is
impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

label: ZKN_PEARL_125_000
text:
Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon
appears at power plants and eats electricity.

label: ZKN_PEARL_126_000
text:
It was born in the crater of a volcano. Its body is
covered with flames that shimmer like the sun.

label: ZKN_PEARL_127_000
text:
It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn
apart. What it can’t tear, it tosses far away.

label: ZKN_PEARL_128_000
text:
Once it takes aim at its prey, it makes a headlong
charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

label: ZKN_PEARL_129_000
text:
It is unable to swim against even slow-moving
currents. It always splashes about for
some reason.

label: ZKN_PEARL_130_000
text:
In ancient literature, there is a record of
a Gyarados that razed a village when
violence flared.

label: ZKN_PEARL_131_000
text:
It loves crossing the sea with people and
Pokémon on its back. It understands
human speech.

label: ZKN_PEARL_132_000
text:
It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular
structure to transform into whatever it sees.

label: ZKN_PEARL_133_000
text:
It is a rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh
environments by changing its appearance and
capabilities when it evolves.

label: ZKN_PEARL_134_000
text:
It has evolved to be suited for an aquatic life.
It can become invisible when it melts away
into water.

label: ZKN_PEARL_135_000
text:
It controls 10,000-volt power. When the fur
covering its body stands on end, the fur is hard
and sharp, like needles.

label: ZKN_PEARL_136_000
text:
It has a flame sac in its body. Its body
temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit
before battle.

label: ZKN_PEARL_137_000
text:
The world’s first artificially created Pokémon.
It can travel through electronic space.

label: ZKN_PEARL_138_000
text:
It’s a Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil
using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

label: ZKN_PEARL_139_000
text:
It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct
because its spiral shell grew too large.

label: ZKN_PEARL_140_000
text:
It is thought to have inhabited beaches
300 million years ago. It is protected by a
sturdy shell.

label: ZKN_PEARL_141_000
text:
It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land
because its prey adapted to life on land.

label: ZKN_PEARL_142_000
text:
It’s a Pokémon that roamed the skies in the
dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

label: ZKN_PEARL_143_000
text:
It stops eating only to sleep. It doesn’t feel full
unless it eats nearly 900 pounds a day.

label: ZKN_PEARL_144_000
text:
This legendary bird Pokémon can create
blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

label: ZKN_PEARL_145_000
text:
This legendary Pokémon is said to live in
thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_PEARL_146_000
text:
It is one of the legendary bird Pokémon.
Its appearance is said to indicate the
coming of spring.

label: ZKN_PEARL_147_000
text:
It is called the Mirage Pokémon because so few
have seen it, but its shed skin has been found.

label: ZKN_PEARL_148_000
text:
If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes
instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_149_000
text:
It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea.
It guides wrecked ships to shore.

label: ZKN_PEARL_150_000
text:
Mewtwo was created by recombining Mew’s
genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart
among Pokémon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_151_000
text:
Because it can use all kinds of moves, many
scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor
of Pokémon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_152_000
text:
It uses the leaf on its head to determine the air’s
temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

label: ZKN_PEARL_153_000
text:
The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma
that perks people up.

label: ZKN_PEARL_154_000
text:
Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead
plants and flowers.

label: ZKN_PEARL_155_000
text:
It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames
on its back burn more vigorously.

label: ZKN_PEARL_156_000
text:
It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames.
The fire burns stronger as it prepares to fight.

label: ZKN_PEARL_157_000
text:
It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat
shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

label: ZKN_PEARL_158_000
text:
It has a habit of biting everything with its
well-developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs
to be careful.

label: ZKN_PEARL_159_000
text:
Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses
its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

label: ZKN_PEARL_160_000
text:
It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding
speed when it attacks and bites prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_161_000
text:
It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high
on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

label: ZKN_PEARL_162_000
text:
The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling
up around them. It corners foes with speed.

label: ZKN_PEARL_163_000
text:
It switches its standing foot so quickly that the
switch can’t be seen. It cries at the same time
every day.

label: ZKN_PEARL_164_000
text:
If it flips its head upside down, it’s a sign that it
is engaged in very complex thinking.

label: ZKN_PEARL_165_000
text:
It’s so timid that it can’t move unless it’s with
a swarm. It conveys its feelings through scent.

label: ZKN_PEARL_166_000
text:
It uses starlight as energy. When more stars
appear at night, the patterns on its back
grow larger.

label: ZKN_PEARL_167_000
text:
It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but
strong thread. It waits motionlessly for prey
to arrive.

label: ZKN_PEARL_168_000
text:
It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free.
Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

label: ZKN_PEARL_169_000
text:
This Pokémon gained vastly enhanced flying
capabilities after its legs became wings.

label: ZKN_PEARL_170_000
text:
It discharges positive and negative electricity
from the tips of its antennae to shock its foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_171_000
text:
Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths.
It is nicknamed the Deep-Sea Star.

label: ZKN_PEARL_172_000
text:
It plays with others by touching tails and setting
off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.

label: ZKN_PEARL_173_000
text:
Many appear when the night skies are filled with
shooting stars. They disappear with sunrise.

label: ZKN_PEARL_174_000
text:
It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts
bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

label: ZKN_PEARL_175_000
text:
Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that
it shares with kindhearted people.

label: ZKN_PEARL_176_000
text:
It is said to appear in front of kindly people to
scatter a glowing down called joy dust.

label: ZKN_PEARL_177_000
text:
It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding
buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

label: ZKN_PEARL_178_000
text:
This odd Pokémon can see both the past and
the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

label: ZKN_PEARL_179_000
text:
Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static
electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

label: ZKN_PEARL_180_000
text:
If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity,
its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire hair that zaps
on impact.

label: ZKN_PEARL_181_000
text:
The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden
days, people sent signals using the light from
this Pokémon’s tail.

label: ZKN_PEARL_182_000
text:
When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn
out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

label: ZKN_PEARL_183_000
text:
The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter
than water, so it acts as a float.

label: ZKN_PEARL_184_000
text:
Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish
the movements of living things on riverbeds.

label: ZKN_PEARL_185_000
text:
It stands along paths pretending to be a tree.
If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.

label: ZKN_PEARL_186_000
text:
A group of Poliwag and Poliwhirl will form with
a Politoed as the leader. Politoed’s cries make
the Pokémon of the group obey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_187_000
text:
They are blown adrift by winds. It is said that
when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains,
spring is on the way.

label: ZKN_PEARL_188_000
text:
It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the
sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

label: ZKN_PEARL_189_000
text:
Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe,
scattering cotton spores as it goes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_190_000
text:
It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a
branch so it won’t fall off while asleep.

label: ZKN_PEARL_191_000
text:
They may suddenly fall out of the sky in the
morning. In the year following a cold summer,
their population explodes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_192_000
text:
It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known
for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

label: ZKN_PEARL_193_000
text:
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without the
Pokémon moving its head. It won’t miss prey—
even those behind it.

label: ZKN_PEARL_194_000
text:
When the temperature cools in the evening,
they emerge from water to seek food along
the shore.

label: ZKN_PEARL_195_000
text:
A dim-witted Pokémon. It doesn’t care if it
bumps its head into boats or rocks
while swimming.

label: ZKN_PEARL_196_000
text:
Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on
its forehead glows when it uses psychic power.

label: ZKN_PEARL_197_000
text:
The light of the moon changed Eevee’s genetic
structure. It lurks in the darkness, waiting for prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_198_000
text:
It appears near travelers to lure them into
deep forests. It is said to bring misfortune.

label: ZKN_PEARL_199_000
text:
Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence
comparable to that of internationally
recognized scientists.

label: ZKN_PEARL_200_000
text:
It gets nourishment from fear that it absorbs into
its red orbs. During the daytime, it sleeps in
the shadows.

label: ZKN_PEARL_201_000
text:
They seem to communicate among each other
telepathically. They are always found stuck
on walls.

label: ZKN_PEARL_202_000
text:
It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden.
This behavior is said to be proof that its tail
hides a secret.

label: ZKN_PEARL_203_000
text:
While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch.
The tail doesn’t need to sleep.

label: ZKN_PEARL_204_000
text:
It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it
from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

label: ZKN_PEARL_205_000
text:
It is encased in a steel shell. Forretress’s eyes
peer out, but what lies within this Pokémon’s
shell is unknown.

label: ZKN_PEARL_206_000
text:
It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a
mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

label: ZKN_PEARL_207_000
text:
It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to
strike from the sky. It aims for the prey’s face.

label: ZKN_PEARL_208_000
text:
It chews its way through boulders with its
sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the
darkness underground.

label: ZKN_PEARL_209_000
text:
Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is,
however, considered by many people to be cute.

label: ZKN_PEARL_210_000
text:
It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes
enraged, however, it will strike with its
huge fangs.

label: ZKN_PEARL_211_000
text:
It shoots the poison spikes on its body in
all directions. Its round form makes it a
poor swimmer.

label: ZKN_PEARL_212_000
text:
It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by
upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

label: ZKN_PEARL_213_000
text:
It stores berries in its shell. The berries mix with
its body fluids to become delicious juices.

label: ZKN_PEARL_214_000
text:
Its powerful legs and claws give it enough
power to hurl foes over great distances.

label: ZKN_PEARL_215_000
text:
It is extremely vicious and will not stop attacking
until its foe is incapable of moving.

label: ZKN_PEARL_216_000
text:
It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them
all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

label: ZKN_PEARL_217_000
text:
In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that
bear delicious berries or fruits.

label: ZKN_PEARL_218_000
text:
Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep
moving, its body will cool and harden.

label: ZKN_PEARL_219_000
text:
Its body temperature is roughly
18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Flames burst from
gaps in its shell made of hardened magma.

label: ZKN_PEARL_220_000
text:
It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead
grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

label: ZKN_PEARL_221_000
text:
Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks
surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

label: ZKN_PEARL_222_000
text:
Many live in the clean seas of the south.
They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

label: ZKN_PEARL_223_000
text:
It clings to Mantine to feed on the big Pokémon’s
scraps. This is an adaptation to avoid foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_224_000
text:
It obscures its foe’s vision by spitting a cloud of
black ink. It makes its nest among boulders.

label: ZKN_PEARL_225_000
text:
It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit
of sharing food with people lost in
the mountains.

label: ZKN_PEARL_226_000
text:
It swims elegantly, mindless of Remoraid hitching
onto its broad fins. It is naturally docile.

label: ZKN_PEARL_227_000
text:
Skarmory is clad entirely in ironhard armor. It flies
at speeds over 180 mph.

label: ZKN_PEARL_228_000
text:
It conveys its feelings using different cries.
It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_229_000
text:
Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be
the call of the grim reaper.

label: ZKN_PEARL_230_000
text:
It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant
whirlpools every time it moves.

label: ZKN_PEARL_231_000
text:
It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily
pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

label: ZKN_PEARL_232_000
text:
It attacks by curling up and rolling into its foe.
It can blow apart a house in one hit.

label: ZKN_PEARL_233_000
text:
With planetary development software installed,
it became capable of working in space.

label: ZKN_PEARL_234_000
text:
Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation
as if one were being drawn into their centers.

label: ZKN_PEARL_235_000
text:
It marks its territory by using its tail like a
paintbrush. There are more than 5,000
different marks.

label: ZKN_PEARL_236_000
text:
It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always
nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_237_000
text:
It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal
force boosts its destructive power by a factor
of 10.

label: ZKN_PEARL_238_000
text:
It tests everything by touching with its lips,
which remember what it likes and dislikes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_239_000
text:
It generates electricity by whirling its arms.
However, it can’t store the energy it makes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_240_000
text:
Its body temperature is around
1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. It is healthy
if it is exhaling yellow flames.

label: ZKN_PEARL_241_000
text:
It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow
up to become hearty, healthy adults.

label: ZKN_PEARL_242_000
text:
It is a Pokémon that delivers happiness. Eating its
egg is said to make one kind to everyone.

label: ZKN_PEARL_243_000
text:
It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire
thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

label: ZKN_PEARL_244_000
text:
It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts
somewhere around the globe.

label: ZKN_PEARL_245_000
text:
It races around the world to purify fouled water.
It dashes away with the north wind.

label: ZKN_PEARL_246_000
text:
This Pokémon eats soil. Once it has eaten a
large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

label: ZKN_PEARL_247_000
text:
Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting
pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

label: ZKN_PEARL_248_000
text:
If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and
buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

label: ZKN_PEARL_249_000
text:
It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings,
it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

label: ZKN_PEARL_250_000
text:
Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that
anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

label: ZKN_PEARL_251_000
text:
It has the power to travel across time, but it is
said to appear only in peaceful times.

label: ZKN_PEARL_252_000
text:
The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny
hooks, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

label: ZKN_PEARL_253_000
text:
It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its
prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

label: ZKN_PEARL_254_000
text:
The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down
thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

label: ZKN_PEARL_255_000
text:
A fire burns inside it, so it feels very warm to hug.
It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_PEARL_256_000
text:
Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per
second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_257_000
text:
Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its
knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_258_000
text:
Using the fin on its head, Mudkip senses the flow
of water to keep track of what’s going on around
it. Mudkip has the strength to heft boulders.

label: ZKN_PEARL_259_000
text:
Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud.
It burrows into dirt to sleep.

label: ZKN_PEARL_260_000
text:
It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes
down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

label: ZKN_PEARL_261_000
text:
A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its
chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

label: ZKN_PEARL_262_000
text:
It chases down prey in a pack. It will never
disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

label: ZKN_PEARL_263_000
text:
It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding
items in the grass and even in the ground.

label: ZKN_PEARL_264_000
text:
It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However,
because it can only run straight, it often fails.

label: ZKN_PEARL_265_000
text:
It spits a white silk thread that turns sticky when
coming into contact with air. The silk is used to
immobilize foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_266_000
text:
It drinks dew that collects on its silk while it waits
for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

label: ZKN_PEARL_267_000
text:
When flower fields bloom, it flits around,
collecting pollen. Despite its appearance,
it is savage.

label: ZKN_PEARL_268_000
text:
Encased within its tough cocoon, it endures
attacks. It never forgets the appearance of
its foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_269_000
text:
It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust
when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

label: ZKN_PEARL_270_000
text:
It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry
for Pokémon that can’t swim.

label: ZKN_PEARL_271_000
text:
It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler,
it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

label: ZKN_PEARL_272_000
text:
If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with
energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.

label: ZKN_PEARL_273_000
text:
When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just
like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon
that try to peck at it.

label: ZKN_PEARL_274_000
text:
The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners
uneasy. It lives deep in the forest.

label: ZKN_PEARL_275_000
text:
By flapping its leafy fans, it can whip up gusts of
100 feet per second that can level houses.

label: ZKN_PEARL_276_000
text:
It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on
tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

label: ZKN_PEARL_277_000
text:
It circles the sky in search of prey and dives
sharply to catch its target.

label: ZKN_PEARL_278_000
text:
Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars
as if it were a glider. It folds its wings to rest.

label: ZKN_PEARL_279_000
text:
It acts as a delivery service by carrying small
Pokémon in its bill. It bobs on the waves to rest.

label: ZKN_PEARL_280_000
text:
It uses the horns on its head to sense human
emotions. It is said to appear in front of
cheerful people.

label: ZKN_PEARL_281_000
text:
It is highly perceptive of its Trainer’s feelings.
It dances when it is feeling happy.

label: ZKN_PEARL_282_000
text:
It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life.
It has the ability to see the future.

label: ZKN_PEARL_283_000
text:
It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws
prey in with a sweet scent released from the
tip of its head.

label: ZKN_PEARL_284_000
text:
Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four
wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

label: ZKN_PEARL_285_000
text:
It spouts poison spores from the top of its head.
These spores cause pain all over the body
if inhaled.

label: ZKN_PEARL_286_000
text:
Its short arms stretch when it throws punches.
Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

label: ZKN_PEARL_287_000
text:
It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out.
Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

label: ZKN_PEARL_288_000
text:
Its heart beats at 10 times its previous rate, so it
cannot sit still for even a moment.

label: ZKN_PEARL_289_000
text:
It is the world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is
lounging, it is actually saving energy for
striking back.

label: ZKN_PEARL_290_000
text:
It grows underground, sensing its surroundings
using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_291_000
text:
Because they move so quickly, they sometimes
become unseeable. They congregate around
tree sap.

label: ZKN_PEARL_292_000
text:
It is a discarded bug shell that came to life.
Peering into the crack on its back is said to
steal one’s spirit.

label: ZKN_PEARL_293_000
text:
Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs.
If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume
as a jet plane.

label: ZKN_PEARL_294_000
text:
The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks.
It stamps its feet to power up.

label: ZKN_PEARL_295_000
text:
Its howls can be heard over six miles away.
It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on
its body.

label: ZKN_PEARL_296_000
text:
It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees.
Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

label: ZKN_PEARL_297_000
text:
It loves to match power with big-bodied
Pokémon. It can send a truck flying with its
arm thrusts.

label: ZKN_PEARL_298_000
text:
Its tail is filled with nutrients necessary for growth.
It plays by bouncing on its tail.

label: ZKN_PEARL_299_000
text:
Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon
always keeps its face pointing north.

label: ZKN_PEARL_300_000
text:
It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things,
and it runs in circles, chasing its own tail.

label: ZKN_PEARL_301_000
text:
It is highly popular among Trainers for its
sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

label: ZKN_PEARL_302_000
text:
It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems
has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

label: ZKN_PEARL_303_000
text:
Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed
by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

label: ZKN_PEARL_304_000
text:
It usually lives deep in mountains. But when it’s
hungry, it shows up at the foot of the mountains
and eats railroad tracks and cars.

label: ZKN_PEARL_305_000
text:
For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely
body against others to fight over territory.

label: ZKN_PEARL_306_000
text:
While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by
breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

label: ZKN_PEARL_307_000
text:
It never misses its daily yoga workouts, and it
heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

label: ZKN_PEARL_308_000
text:
Through daily meditation, it hones its spiritual
power. It can sense what others are thinking.

label: ZKN_PEARL_309_000
text:
Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its
muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

label: ZKN_PEARL_310_000
text:
It discharges electricity from its mane.
The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead
from which to drop lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_PEARL_311_000
text:
It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of
sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

label: ZKN_PEARL_312_000
text:
It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing,
its body lets off more and more sparks.

label: ZKN_PEARL_313_000
text:
It communicates with others by lighting up its rear
at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.

label: ZKN_PEARL_314_000
text:
With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw
signs with light in the night sky.

label: ZKN_PEARL_315_000
text:
The beautiful flowers on its arms have toxic
thorns. Don’t even think about picking
those flowers.

label: ZKN_PEARL_316_000
text:
Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh
digestive juices quickly dissolve anything
it swallows.

label: ZKN_PEARL_317_000
text:
It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids
from its follicles to douse foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_318_000
text:
They swarm any foe that invades their territory.
Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

label: ZKN_PEARL_319_000
text:
Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at
75 mph and is known as the Bully of the Sea.

label: ZKN_PEARL_320_000
text:
On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like
a ball and play. It spouts water from its nostrils.

label: ZKN_PEARL_321_000
text:
It’s the biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a
depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

label: ZKN_PEARL_322_000
text:
Its humped back stores intensely hot magma.
In rain, the magma cools, slowing Numel down.

label: ZKN_PEARL_323_000
text:
It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up
in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

label: ZKN_PEARL_324_000
text:
It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows
out black soot if it is in a tough situation.

label: ZKN_PEARL_325_000
text:
It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring.
The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

label: ZKN_PEARL_326_000
text:
It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power.
It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_327_000
text:
No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots.
Their tottering steps hinder the aim of foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_328_000
text:
It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in
wait at the bottom for prey to come
tumbling down.

label: ZKN_PEARL_329_000
text:
It violently shudders its wings, generating
ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

label: ZKN_PEARL_330_000
text:
It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its
wings. It is known as the Desert Spirit.

label: ZKN_PEARL_331_000
text:
By storing water in its body, this desert dweller
can survive for 30 days without water.

label: ZKN_PEARL_332_000
text:
It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is
exhausted from the day’s desert heat.

label: ZKN_PEARL_333_000
text:
Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on
someone’s head, it looks like a cotton hat.

label: ZKN_PEARL_334_000
text:
It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight.
It hums with its soprano voice.

label: ZKN_PEARL_335_000
text:
It has feuded with Seviper for many generations.
Its sharp claws are its greatest weapons.

label: ZKN_PEARL_336_000
text:
For many generations, it has feuded with
Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks
for battle.

label: ZKN_PEARL_337_000
text:
It becomes active on nights with a full moon, so
it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

label: ZKN_PEARL_338_000
text:
This new Pokémon species is rumored to be an
avatar of the sun. The Pokémon gives off light
while spinning.

label: ZKN_PEARL_339_000
text:
Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used
to locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.

label: ZKN_PEARL_340_000
text:
As a result of causing tremors by thrashing about,
it developed the ability to foretell real quakes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_341_000
text:
Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any
environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_342_000
text:
It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and
toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

label: ZKN_PEARL_343_000
text:
It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare
Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

label: ZKN_PEARL_344_000
text:
An ancient clay figurine was exposed to a
mysterious ray of light, and it came to life
as a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_345_000
text:
It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago
and was reanimated scientifically.

label: ZKN_PEARL_346_000
text:
It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the
tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

label: ZKN_PEARL_347_000
text:
This Pokémon ancestor was reanimated from a
fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with its claws.

label: ZKN_PEARL_348_000
text:
It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is
clad in a sturdy armor.

label: ZKN_PEARL_349_000
text:
It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted
streams and lakes. No one pays any attention
to it.

label: ZKN_PEARL_350_000
text:
It is the world’s most beautiful Pokémon. There
are many works of art featuring Milotic.

label: ZKN_PEARL_351_000
text:
Its appearance changes with the weather.
Recently, its molecules were found to be just
like water.

label: ZKN_PEARL_352_000
text:
It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag
pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.

label: ZKN_PEARL_353_000
text:
They love vengeful emotions and hang in rows
under the eaves of houses where vengeful
people live.

label: ZKN_PEARL_354_000
text:
A doll bore a grudge over being junked, and
it became a Pokémon. It seeks the child that
disowned it.

label: ZKN_PEARL_355_000
text:
It doggedly pursues its prey wherever the
prey goes. However, the chase is abandoned
at sunrise.

label: ZKN_PEARL_356_000
text:
Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look
into its body are sucked into the void.

label: ZKN_PEARL_357_000
text:
Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit,
the fruit started growing around its neck.

label: ZKN_PEARL_358_000
text:
Chimecho emits ultrasonic cries. It floats on
the wind to travel great distances.

label: ZKN_PEARL_359_000
text:
It senses coming disasters and appears before
people only to warn them of impending danger.

label: ZKN_PEARL_360_000
text:
They grow strong by pushing up against one
another en masse. They love eating sweet fruit.

label: ZKN_PEARL_361_000
text:
In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a
house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

label: ZKN_PEARL_362_000
text:
To protect itself, it clad its body in an armor of
ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

label: ZKN_PEARL_363_000
text:
It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its
body is poorly shaped for swimming.

label: ZKN_PEARL_364_000
text:
It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so,
it learns textures and odors.

label: ZKN_PEARL_365_000
text:
It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber
repels not only the cold but also enemy attacks.

label: ZKN_PEARL_366_000
text:
It makes a single pearl during its lifetime.
The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

label: ZKN_PEARL_367_000
text:
It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a
small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_368_000
text:
It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the
springtime, its pink body turns more vivid
for some reason.

label: ZKN_PEARL_369_000
text:
This rare Pokémon was discovered during a
deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in
over 100 million years.

label: ZKN_PEARL_370_000
text:
It lives in warm seas. It is said that couples
who find this Pokémon will be blessed with
eternal love.

label: ZKN_PEARL_371_000
text:
Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by
leaping off cliffs every day.

label: ZKN_PEARL_372_000
text:
Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun
changing. The shell peels off the instant the
Pokémon evolves.

label: ZKN_PEARL_373_000
text:
As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its
cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

label: ZKN_PEARL_374_000
text:
They converse with one another by using
magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in
perfect unison.

label: ZKN_PEARL_375_000
text:
It is formed by two Beldum joining together.
Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides
with a jet.

label: ZKN_PEARL_376_000
text:
Metang combined to form it. With four brains,
it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

label: ZKN_PEARL_377_000
text:
Its entire body is made of rock. If any part
chips off in battle, Regirock attaches rocks
to repair itself.

label: ZKN_PEARL_378_000
text:
Its body is made of ice from the ice age.
It controls frigid air of −328 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_PEARL_379_000
text:
Tempered by pressure underground over tens of
thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

label: ZKN_PEARL_380_000
text:
Its body is covered with a down that can refract
light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

label: ZKN_PEARL_381_000
text:
It is a highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back
its forelegs in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_382_000
text:
It is said to have widened the seas by causing
downpours. It had been asleep in a
marine trench.

label: ZKN_PEARL_383_000
text:
It had been asleep in underground magma ever
since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

label: ZKN_PEARL_384_000
text:
It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds
and cannot be seen from the ground.

label: ZKN_PEARL_385_000
text:
It is said to wake up for just seven days every
1,000 years and use its power to grant any wish.

label: ZKN_PEARL_386_000
text:
An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteorite
underwent a DNA mutation to become
this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_387_000
text:
It undertakes photosynthesis within its body,
making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if the
Pokémon is thirsty.

label: ZKN_PEARL_388_000
text:
Its shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to
peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.

label: ZKN_PEARL_389_000
text:
Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of
water have been mistaken for moving forests.

label: ZKN_PEARL_390_000
text:
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its
belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

label: ZKN_PEARL_391_000
text:
It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks.
Its fiery tail is but one of its weapons.

label: ZKN_PEARL_392_000
text:
Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature.
It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

label: ZKN_PEARL_393_000
text:
It lives along the shore in northern countries.
A skilled swimmer, it dives for over
10 minutes while hunting.

label: ZKN_PEARL_394_000
text:
Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the
thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.

label: ZKN_PEARL_395_000
text:
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its
wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

label: ZKN_PEARL_396_000
text:
Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable
when alone. Its cries are very strident.

label: ZKN_PEARL_397_000
text:
They live in forests and fields. Squabbles over
territory occur when flocks collide.

label: ZKN_PEARL_398_000
text:
The muscles in its wings and legs are strong.
It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_399_000
text:
It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle
down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

label: ZKN_PEARL_400_000
text:
While its movements out of water are sluggish,
it can swim as fast as any Feebas.

label: ZKN_PEARL_401_000
text:
It chats with others using the sounds of
its colliding antennae. These sounds are
the hallmarks of fall evenings.

label: ZKN_PEARL_402_000
text:
It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists
are studying these melodic patterns.

label: ZKN_PEARL_403_000
text:
Its forelegs have a muscle-based system of
generating electricity. Its body shines when
it is in danger.

label: ZKN_PEARL_404_000
text:
It rests its forelegs on others to communicate
with rhythmic electric pulses from its claws.

label: ZKN_PEARL_405_000
text:
When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding
prey—even those taking shelter behind a wall.

label: ZKN_PEARL_406_000
text:
It lives alongside clear ponds. It scatters pollen
that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.

label: ZKN_PEARL_407_000
text:
With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with
whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

label: ZKN_PEARL_408_000
text:
It was resurrected from an iron-ball-like fossil.
It downs prey with its headbutts.

label: ZKN_PEARL_409_000
text:
Its skull is as hard as iron. It is a brute that tears
down jungle trees while catching prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_410_000
text:
It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against
tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.

label: ZKN_PEARL_411_000
text:
When attacked, they form a wall with their
shield-like faces to protect their young.

label: ZKN_PEARL_412_000
text:
If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes
the cloak with materials nearby.

label: ZKN_PEARL_413_000
text:
Its appearance changes depending on where it
evolved. The materials on hand become a part
of its body.

label: ZKN_PEARL_414_000
text:
It does not keep a nest. It flies over fields
and mountains in constant search of its
much-beloved nectar.

label: ZKN_PEARL_415_000
text:
They collect and deliver honey to their colony.
At night, they cluster to form a beehive
and sleep.

label: ZKN_PEARL_416_000
text:
When it is in danger, grubs from its six-cell
honeycomb strike back. There is only one
in a colony.

label: ZKN_PEARL_417_000
text:
It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and
shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.

label: ZKN_PEARL_418_000
text:
It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw.
When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

label: ZKN_PEARL_419_000
text:
Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing
aquatic prey. Floatzel carries people as if it were
a rubber raft.

label: ZKN_PEARL_420_000
text:
Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is
drained of nutrients and shriveled, evolution
is near.

label: ZKN_PEARL_421_000
text:
It is docile as a bud and turns cheerful when it
blooms. It folds back into a bud if sunlight wanes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_422_000
text:
It lives along bodies of water. Its body shape
changed to suit its habitat.

label: ZKN_PEARL_423_000
text:
It apparently had a huge shell for protection in
ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

label: ZKN_PEARL_424_000
text:
They work in large colonies and make rings by
linking their tails, apparently in friendship.

label: ZKN_PEARL_425_000
text:
It tugs on the hands of children to spirit them
away. However, it gets pulled around instead.

label: ZKN_PEARL_426_000
text:
It carries people and Pokémon when it flies.
But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.

label: ZKN_PEARL_427_000
text:
When it senses danger, it perks up its ears.
On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into
its fur.

label: ZKN_PEARL_428_000
text:
It likes to keep itself clean and never fails to
groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

label: ZKN_PEARL_429_000
text:
It chants incantations. While these incantations
can torment targets, some bring happiness.

label: ZKN_PEARL_430_000
text:
It makes its Murkrow cronies bring it food. It idles
its time away, grooming itself in its nest.

label: ZKN_PEARL_431_000
text:
With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild
hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_432_000
text:
To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy,
it tightly cinches its waist with its split tail.

label: ZKN_PEARL_433_000
text:
Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound.
It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.

label: ZKN_PEARL_434_000
text:
It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear
to repel attackers.

label: ZKN_PEARL_435_000
text:
It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid
smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester
in its belly.

label: ZKN_PEARL_436_000
text:
X-ray photos were taken to check its body
structure, but nothing was seen.

label: ZKN_PEARL_437_000
text:
It can summon rain clouds. People long ago
revered it as the bringer of plentiful harvests.

label: ZKN_PEARL_438_000
text:
It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from
its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.

label: ZKN_PEARL_439_000
text:
It likes places where people gather. It mimics
foes to confuse them, then makes its getaway.

label: ZKN_PEARL_440_000
text:
It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly
pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

label: ZKN_PEARL_441_000
text:
It keeps rhythm by flicking its tail feathers like
a metronome. It also imitates human speech.

label: ZKN_PEARL_442_000
text:
It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as
punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

label: ZKN_PEARL_443_000
text:
It once lived in the tropics. To avoid the cold,
it lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat.

label: ZKN_PEARL_444_000
text:
It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest.
Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

label: ZKN_PEARL_445_000
text:
It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane.
It never allows its prey to escape.

label: ZKN_PEARL_446_000
text:
It hides food under its long body hair. However,
it forgets it has hidden the food.

label: ZKN_PEARL_447_000
text:
Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three
mountains and cross two canyons in one night.

label: ZKN_PEARL_448_000
text:
By sensing the aura emanating from others, it can
read their thoughts and movements.

label: ZKN_PEARL_449_000
text:
It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from
germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

label: ZKN_PEARL_450_000
text:
Its huge mouth opens almost seven feet wide.
It has enough power to completely crush a car.

label: ZKN_PEARL_451_000
text:
It lives in arid lands. It buries itself in sand and
lies in wait for unsuspecting prey.

label: ZKN_PEARL_452_000
text:
Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head
rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.

label: ZKN_PEARL_453_000
text:
It inflates its poison sacs and makes a blubbering
sound to intimidate foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_454_000
text:
The toxin made in its poison sac is pumped to
the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

label: ZKN_PEARL_455_000
text:
Using its tentacles to hang from branches,
it looks like a plant when it is not moving.
It awaits prey with its mouth wide open.

label: ZKN_PEARL_456_000
text:
The way its two tail fins flutter while it swims has
earned it the nickname Beautifly of the Sea.

label: ZKN_PEARL_457_000
text:
To avoid detection by predators, it crawls along
the seafloor using the two fins on its chest.

label: ZKN_PEARL_458_000
text:
Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns
on its back differ by region.

label: ZKN_PEARL_459_000
text:
In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of
frozen treats around its belly.

label: ZKN_PEARL_460_000
text:
It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up
blizzards. It is also known as the Ice Monster.

label: ZKN_PEARL_461_000
text:
It sends signals to others of its kind by carving
odd patterns on trees and ice.

label: ZKN_PEARL_462_000
text:
It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic
field. Its three units generate magnetism.

label: ZKN_PEARL_463_000
text:
It wraps things with its extensible tongue.
Getting too close to it will leave you soaked
with drool.

label: ZKN_PEARL_464_000
text:
It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its
muscles to shoot them. On rare occasions,
the Pokémon even shoots out Geodude.

label: ZKN_PEARL_465_000
text:
It ensnares prey by extending arms made of
vines. Losing arms to predators does not
trouble it.

label: ZKN_PEARL_466_000
text:
It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe,
then lets loose with over 20,000 volts
of electricity.

label: ZKN_PEARL_467_000
text:
It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees
Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms.
It lives in volcanic craters.

label: ZKN_PEARL_468_000
text:
It will never appear where there is strife.
Sightings of this Pokémon have recently
become rare.

label: ZKN_PEARL_469_000
text:
By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that
inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_470_000
text:
Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis.
As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

label: ZKN_PEARL_471_000
text:
As a defense mechanism, it can completely
freeze its fur to make its hairs stand out
like needles.

label: ZKN_PEARL_472_000
text:
It observes prey while hanging inverted from
branches. When the chance presents itself,
Gliscor swoops!

label: ZKN_PEARL_473_000

Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The ice age
is over and the climate has warmed, so this
Pokémon’s population has thinned.

label: ZKN_PEARL_474_000
text:
Additional software was installed to make it an
even better Pokémon. It began acting
oddly, however.

label: ZKN_PEARL_475_000
text:
A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights
using the extending swords on its elbows.

label: ZKN_PEARL_476_000
text:
Its entire body exudes strong magnetism.
Probopass controls three small units
called Mini-Noses.

label: ZKN_PEARL_477_000
text:
The antenna on its head captures radio waves
from the world of spirits that command it to take
people there.

label: ZKN_PEARL_478_000
text:
It freezes foes with an icy breath that is nearly
−60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its
body is actually hollow.

label: ZKN_PEARL_479_000
text:
Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to
infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

label: ZKN_PEARL_480_000
text:
It is said that its emergence gave humans the
intelligence to improve their quality of life.

label: ZKN_PEARL_481_000
text:
It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said
to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.

label: ZKN_PEARL_482_000
text:
It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all
came from the same egg.

label: ZKN_PEARL_483_000
text:
This Pokémon is spoken of in legend. It is said
that time began moving when Dialga was born.

label: ZKN_PEARL_484_000
text:
It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension
parallel to ours. Palkia appears in mythology.

label: ZKN_PEARL_485_000
text:
It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its
cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

label: ZKN_PEARL_486_000
text:
There is an enduring legend that states this
Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

label: ZKN_PEARL_487_000

A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on
the reverse side of ours. It appears in an
ancient cemetery.

label: ZKN_PEARL_488_000
text:
When it flies, it releases shiny particles from
its veil-like wings. It is said to represent the
crescent moon.

label: ZKN_PEARL_489_000
text:
A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates
the flotation sac on its head to drift and search
for food.

label: ZKN_PEARL_490_000
text:
Water makes up 80 percent of its body.
This Pokémon is easily affected by
its environment.

label: ZKN_PEARL_491_000
text:
Folklore has it that on moonless nights,
this Pokémon will make people see
horrific nightmares.

text:
It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly
